_comment: Golf (card game) locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[draw]', '[take]', '[swap X Y]', '[discard]', '[knock]', '[peek X Y]'), the card labels (A, 2-10, J, Q, K), the suit symbols, the letters X/Y used as row/column placeholders in tokens, or numeric scores/positions. Keep the ASCII grid layout (spacing, column numbers, '?', 'Col', 'Row' alignment) intact so the board stays readable.

_slots.{winner}: The player number with the lowest score
_slots.{card}: A card label such as A♠, 10♥, K♦ or Q♣
_slots.{new}: The card label that was placed into the grid
_slots.{old}: The card label that was removed from the grid
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered phrase describing why the final round started
_slots.{n}: A row number shown at the start of a grid row
_slots.{cards}: The pre-rendered, layout-sensitive cells of one grid row
_slots.{discard}: The card label on top of the discard pile, or the word for 'none'
_slots.{options}: The pre-rendered line listing available actions
_slots.{scores}: The pre-rendered per-player list of final scores

player_prompt.intro:
You are playing Golf (Card Game) - Player {player_id}.
Goal: Get the lowest total score in this single round. If columns share the same value, they are summed as 0.
Card Values: A=1, 2-10=face value, J/Q=10, K=0

Actions (use exact brackets):
- '[draw]' - Draw from deck
- '[take]' - Take from discard pile
- '[swap X Y]' - Swap drawn card with position X (row) Y (column)
- '[discard]' - Discard the drawn card

board.drew:
You drew: {card}
Now you must [swap X Y] or [discard] it.
board.took:
Ti ê pigiò: {card} da-o disco de carte scartae
Ti devi [swap X Y] con lô (nò pôi scartâ)

options.final_turns: Torni finæ! E tê opçioin: [draw], [take], [peek X Y]
options.must_swap: Ti devi: [swap X Y] (no ti peu scartâ de carte da pila d'escartamento)

action_desc.swapped: Giougadô {pid} a scangiò {new} con {old} a-a poxiçion ({row},{col})

message.deck_empty: A pòrta a l'é sciortia, o zeneize finisce.
message.knocked: O zugatô {pid} o l'é sciortîo! Ogni atro zùgno o gh'à un turno de ciù.
message.final_round: Giougadô {pid} {reason}! Ogni atro giougadô o l'ha 'n atro tornò

reason.all_revealed: o l'à mostrou tutte e carte?

invalid.wrong_action: Dêuvi un'açion con brachette: [draw], [take], [swap X Y], [discard], [knock], o [peek X Y]
invalid.discard_empty: A pila de scarto a l'é sciù!
invalid.must_draw_first: You must first [draw], [take], [knock], or [peek X Y]
invalid.cannot_discard_taken: No ti peu scartâ unna carta piggiâ da-a pila de scarto, l'é beseugno cangiâla.
invalid.have_drawn_card: Ti ê tirò 'na carta. Ti devi [swap X Y] o [discard]
invalid.need_drawn_swap: Ti gh'æ beseugno de unna carta desegnâ pe scambiâ.
invalid.need_drawn_discard: Ti gh'æ beseugno de unna carta desfâ pe scartâla.
invalid.out_of_bounds: Poxiçion fêua di limiti. Dêuvi a riga 1-{max_row}, colonna 1-{max_col}
invalid.knock_with_card: No ti peu batte con unna carta tirâ.
invalid.already_knocked: Unn'atra persoña a l'à za fæto sto giro.
invalid.already_revealed: Sta carta a l'é za stæta rivelaa!

summary.line: Zeneize: {pid} de puntin pe-o zugatô {score} de punte

board_str.title: === GOLF GAME=== O l'é stæto un bon giorno.
